topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic mutations and epigenetic mechanisms in clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages that drive clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine whether tumors originate from tissue stem cells or differentiated progenitors across leukemia and colorectal cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental influences, investigative methods, and cancer evolution synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how permissive microenvironments and inflammation drive malignancy, the modern tools used to profile these interactions, and the resulting integrated model of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and previews the next lecture on cancer therapy.
